app.name: HuiLu
app.tagline: Local meeting notes: record audio / screen → transcribe → AI summary

popup.title: Record
popup.sourceDesktopHint: A picker will open. Tick “Share audio” to record sound
popup.micNeedsPermission: Microphone access is needed the first time
popup.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings and try again

sidepanel.endedBySource: The tab was closed or sharing stopped, so the recording ended
sidepanel.endedByError: Writing to disk failed, so the recording stopped. Everything recorded before that was saved
sidepanel.notSaved: The recording could not be saved: {{error}}
sidepanel.hint: Click “Start recording” in the popup, or press Alt+Shift+R to record the current tab

warning.micUnavailable: The microphone could not be opened; this recording has no microphone audio
warning.noAudio: No audio is being captured; this recording cannot be transcribed
warning.lowStorage: Less than one hour of storage left

error.busy: A recording is already in progress
error.noAudio: Nothing to record: the source has no audio and the microphone is off or unavailable
error.storage: Not enough storage to start recording
error.permission: Cannot capture this page: permission denied, or the page cannot be recorded (e.g. chrome:// pages)

unfinished.title: Unfinished recordings found
unfinished.body: A recording was interrupted (e.g. the browser crashed). What was recorded is still here
unfinished.confirmDiscard: Discard it? The recorded content will be deleted
unfinished.nothingToRecover: “{{title}}” had nothing to recover and was removed

permissions.micBody: HuiLu records in the background and cannot show the permission prompt there. Click the button below and choose “Allow” in the browser prompt.
permissions.micGranted: Done. You can close this page and start recording from the popup.
